checks.claim: C1: The family is the actual general nonnegative nonzero compact psi with the original d1 Riesz/white amplitude and fractional time covariance, and h_sigma=Gamma*q_sigma is distributional.
checks.reason: Target lines 9-19 match tilt Section 1. Fubini for a nonnegative integrand and positive Radon Gamma gives h_sigma=Gamma*q_sigma=h(sigma,.) of tilt (5). The covariance is declared shorthand, with no point evaluation of noise. Tilt Section 3 assumes only real psi, so the positive nonseparable subclass is covered. The condition alpha+a<2 is redundant here but harmless.

checks.claim: C1: sigma is an index in [0,1], not an amplitude, and q_sigma>=q_avg>=0 is nonzero with a legal common compact support.
checks.reason: For sigma,u in [0,1], |sigma-u|<=1 and a>0 give kernel >=1, so q_sigma>=q_avg, including at sigma=0 where the potential is nonzero. Because the kernel is strictly positive, {q_sigma>0}={q_avg>0}, so the supports are literally the same. Spatial derivatives pass under the integrable kernel, so q_sigma is smooth. Positivity of Gamma gives h_sigma>=U_avg. Lines 20-22 separate q_avg from q_0 and sigma from coupling.

This closes the single V1 required repair, and no interpretation had to be supplied.

Positivity: J_phi(e_sigma)=integral phi p_sigma>0, because the C2 representative of p_sigma is pointwise positive and phi is nonnegative and nonzero. Boundedness plus continuity of e_sigma in F from S2 makes this continuous on compact [0,1], so the infimum is positive. No S2 proof is accepted here; the target correctly labels both as obligations.

checks.claim: C5: The white two-bump witness refutes a universal exact h_sigma=b(sigma)U representation on its own scope.
checks.reason: Independently recomputed. psi is legal, nonnegative, nonzero and supported in (1/8,1/4)x(-2,-1) union (3/4,7/8)x(1,2). The substitution v=1-u gives h_0=c(Aq1+Bq2) and h_1=c(Bq1+Aq2). A>B>0 because u<1-u on supp f1, a>0, and f1 is positive on an open set. Disjoint bumps give determinant c^2(A^2-B^2)q1(x1)q2(x2)>0 with the amplitude retained, while any b(sigma)U has determinant 0 including when b vanishes. The two time slices also rule out a single product form of psi. White with a<1 is inside the model.
